//go:build !js

package app

import (
	"errors"
	nextgo "github.com/Suhaibinator/Next.go"
	"github.com/Suhaibinator/Next.go/ui"
)

func Page(c *nextgo.Context) (nextgo.Page, error) {
	if c.Query.Get("mode") == "layout" {
		return nextgo.Page{Body: ui.Text("discarded page")}, nil
	}
	return nextgo.Page{}, errors.New("private page cause")
}
func Layout(c *nextgo.Context, n ui.Node) (ui.Node, error) {
	if c.Query.Get("mode") == "layout" {
		return nil, errors.New("private layout cause")
	}
	return ui.El("section", ui.Attrs{"data-route-layout": ""}, n), nil
}
func Error(c *nextgo.Context, _ error) (nextgo.Page, error) {
	if c.Query.Get("mode") == "local" {
		return nextgo.Page{Body: ui.Text("Local replacement")}, nil
	}
	if c.Query.Get("mode") == "boundary-panic" {
		panic("private local panic")
	}
	return nextgo.Page{}, errors.New("private local cause")
}
func NotFound(*nextgo.Context) (nextgo.Page, error) {
	return nextgo.Page{}, errors.New("private missing cause")
}
func GlobalError(c *nextgo.Context, _ error) (nextgo.Page, error) {
	if c.Query.Get("mode") == "global-panic" {
		panic("private global cause")
	}
	if _, e := c.Slot("protected"); !errors.Is(e, nextgo.ErrSlotScope) {
		return nextgo.Page{}, errors.New("private slot authority")
	}
	if e := c.SetHeader("X-Global-Fallback", "yes"); e != nil {
		return nextgo.Page{}, e
	}
	return nextgo.Page{Title: "Global fallback", Body: ui.El("main", ui.Attrs{"data-global-fallback": ""}, ui.Text("Global replacement"))}, nil
}
